plansIntro: A service called meshcoreprofiles.com is planned, integrated with the worldwide node map.
plansBullet1: Users who submit their companion or repeater details will get their own profile.
plansBullet2: Selected profile information will be shown directly on the map, making it easy to see who a given node belongs to.
plansBullet3: Repeater owners will be able to upload photos, which will then be displayed publicly on the site.
plansBeta: A test version of the configurator is currently available only to members of the MeshCore Polska Discord server (the /konfigurator command by Sefi#6347). See an example.
